newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 28.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following stories on its business page March 28:

NEW YORK - Rising interest rates and new signs of a strong economy pummeled stock and bond prices with the Dow Jones industrial average falling more than 200 points before recovering to close the day off 140.11 points.
WASHINGTON - Like an airplane struggling through stormy weather, the stock market hit enough of a downdraft to upset the tummies of some investors.
WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve officials voted unanimously last month to leave short-term interest rates unchanged, according to minutes of a Feb. 4-5 policymaking session released Thursday.

NEW YORK - Vietnamese women as young as 15 toil for 20 cents an hour to make one million Nike shoes a month, suffering corporal punishment and sexual harassment, according to a report released Thursday.
